hints: Two switches, two gates, and vents on their own beats all the way into the Crown.
Walk each hall carefully, flip a switch when you stand on one, and turn right at every wall.

story.intro: VANTA: "The sun mirrors are mine. One beam from the Crown and every tower in the desert answers to me."
story.outro: PATCH: "Mirrors down, Crown dark, and VANTA's fleeing east. The Sandglass is cooling. You did it, LoopBot."
